note: D9 starting spec for pour tea, written in tokens to mirror manip_sim/pour_stages.py: the carry holds teapot.up_axis to world.z (tight) with translation free (the path holds from the lifted entry, so no band there); the carry goal puts the spout tip centered (moderate) over the opening at clearance large / slack snug, the same band as the pour path, so the hand-off lies inside the pour's path; the pour tips teapot.front_axis to mug.-up (tight), a sweep about the teapot's lateral axis, with the spout tip held over the opening

emissions.name: grasp the teapot by its handle
emissions.verify: The gripper is closed on the handle with the grasp point at teapot.handle_center; the teapot is still upright at its spawn pose.
emissions.goal: The gripper closes on the teapot's handle at teapot.handle_center, with the teapot still upright at its spawn pose.

emissions.name: carry the teapot upright over the mug
emissions.verify: Along the carry teapot.+up stays vertical (no spill) while translation is free; at the goal teapot.spout_tip is horizontally centered on mug.opening_center and 8-20 cm above it, so the pot body and base stay clear of the mug rim and table, and the pour stage can descend from this hover height.
emissions.goal: teapot.spout_tip ends up centered over mug.opening_center and hovering well above it, high enough that the whole pot body clears the mug rim, with teapot.+up still pointing the way world.z points.

emissions.name: pour
emissions.verify: The teapot rotates about its level lateral axis, spout first, until teapot.+front points the way mug.-up points, while teapot.spout_tip stays horizontally over mug.opening_center for the whole descent and tilt and ends 1-6 cm above it.
emissions.goal: The teapot tips forward about its level lateral axis until teapot.+front (the spout direction) points the way mug.-up points, with teapot.spout_tip descending from the hover height to just above mug.opening_center and staying horizontally over it so the tea falls into the mug.
